headline: Charles River (CRL) Is Up 11.0% After Raising Adjusted EPS Outlook Amid Divestiture-Driven GAAP Losses – Has The Bull Case Changed?
summary: In August 2026, Charles River Laboratories International reported second-quarter revenue of US$1,004.08 million, swinging to a small net loss, and simultaneously cut its 2026 GAAP EPS guidance to US$3.05–US$3.35 per share, largely due to losses tied to recent divestitures.
